saw_lines: Buyers of appliances and electronics compare prices and check delivery before they buy, and they rarely buy on the first ad.
So the sale is won in the first line, with a price, a number or a delivery promise.
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to weigh against the price. Collect one review count or orders shipped figure and lead your next batch with it, keeping it on every creative.
0 of 27 copy ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer sees no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to click now, a first order offer or a bundle, and open three new ads with it.
Your 27 copy ads open with 18 different stories, and the biggest opener is used by only 2 ads. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them, using each in three new ads.
Your ads push Learn more on 24 of 30 ads, so a buyer ready to buy gets an invitation to read. Switch three of those ads to Shop now, sending them to a product page with a visible price.
